title: The graph-model comparison intertwines successive projections
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, f:X→Y a morphism of arbitrary schemes with supplied open/proper compactification c, and t=(a,e,p) a proper/open/proper presentation of f. Let B be the explicit sfGraphCompactificationComparison from c to Rp_*De_!Ra_* [lem-etale-unbounded-compact-support-composition]. For every M in D(X_et,A) and K in D(Y_et,A), tensoring B_M with K followed by sfGraphWordProjection(t;M,K) equals the canonical compactification projection followed by B evaluated at M tensor Lf*K. Use exactly the pullback compositor specified in sfGraphWordProjection [def-sf-etale-graph-word-projection]. No qc, Noetherianity or boundedness hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: nonempty_iso_rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification, eA/eC/eB; nonempty_iso_rightDerivedLowerShriek_comp, e1/e3/e2. Tensor calculation: literature/stacks-project/sites-cohomology.tex, equation-projection-formula-map and lemma-j-shriek-and-tensor; literature/stacks-project/more-etale.tex, lemma-shriek-proper-and-open.

proof.text: Use the explicit graph factorization B = B1 D B2 inverse. It is proved by comparing the existing definitions, with their functor associators retained.

Apply the separate B1, D and B2 projection squares. Postcompose the desired equality by B2 at M tensor Lf*K. Replace the word projection for t followed by B2 using the B2 square. Functoriality of tensor makes the images of B2 inverse and B2 cancel. Then use the D square and the B1 square. The result is the desired equality after cancellation of B2. Only isomorphism components, not projection maps, are cancelled.

proof_origin.place: eA/eC/eB; E5 formalizes the componentwise pasting and inverse-isomorphism cancellation, leaving the three constituent tensor squares separately.

lean.statement:
theorem sfGraphCompactificationComparison_projection
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} (c : Compactification f)
    (t : EtaleGraphPresentation f)
    (M : DerivedCategoryModule A X) (K : DerivedCategoryModule A Y) :
    ((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) Y).map
        ((sfGraphPresentationComparison A c t).hom.app M)).app K ≫
      sfGraphWordProjection A t M K =
    sfCompactProjection A c M K ≫
      (sfGraphPresentationComparison A c t).hom.app
        (((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).obj M).obj
          ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).leftDerivedFunctor.obj K))
